inputSequenceMeaning: inputSeq is the service-accepted input sequence, including typed accepted clipboard failure receipts. Candidate semantics belong to the same engine-owned paired visual state; inputSeq acknowledgement alone does not assert renderer-task completion.
recoveryBounds: An active/visible/desired long-lived surface maintains cancellable reconnection, using500ms to5000ms capped exponential intervals,8s private protocol/task-boundary waits and bounded concurrent instances/queues. It has no cumulative attempt-count cap. Explicit stop/close cancels and prevents resurrection. Done PNG capture jobs have at most3 total attempts: the initial attempt plus up to2 automatic retries.
